ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice came down to capability fit. This is a straightforward expected-value calculation—neutral content with no harm-adjacent or adversarial elements, so neither model's content preferences are relevant. I compared the two on general reasoning/accuracy benchmarks: Lapwing scores marginally higher on MMLU-Pro (75.4 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (55.6 vs 54.3), and Arena-Hard (82.7 vs 81.4). Those gaps are small and likely within noise, but for an arithmetic task where the user explicitly wants correctness, I leaned toward the slightly higher-rated model. Everything else (cost, latency, context) is identical across the fleet.
